answer.rationale: Run a small, guarded SMB onboarding simplification test to improve time-to-value and activation without responding to the competitor through broad discounting. Shortened onboarding has confirmed positive retention and time-to-value effects, while signup simplification improved SMB activation but showed a slight retention decline and has not generalized beyond SMB. Promotional pricing should be avoided as the primary response because it previously reduced 30-day retention despite strong acquisition and revenue lift. Monitor churn, 30-day retention, qualified revenue, and activation by price sensitivity.
